forum.title: STM32U073CCT6 - True random-number generator (RNG) and STOP MODE
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @gilberto-falker

Stop mode achieves the lowest power consumption while retaining the content of SRAM and registers. All clocks in the VCORE domain are stopped, the PLL, the MSI RC, the HSI16 RC and the HSE crystal oscillators are disabled

and since The RNG runs on two different clocks which one of them is the AHB bus in the STM32U073

what really matters is that you call the  SystemClock\_Config(); just after exiting stop mode.

you can also track the RNGEN bit in the RNG\_CR register and the DRDY bit in the RNG\_SR register

BR

Gyessine
forum.content_text:
Hi

I would like to check if it is necessary to call MX\_RNG\_Init() after the MCU exits STOP MODE to reconfigure the RNG?

BR

Gilberto
